title: Finance & Audit Desk — Follow-up and Morning Briefing
governing_principle: Jarvis and Vyomaraj always follow up with the Finance and auditing agents. They check the data, follow up with the social platforms, email them and call them to remind them about payments and delayed payments — and every morning they share updates and data with the owner through voice, email, text or WhatsApp.

reminder_ladder.tone: friendly confirmation of the upcoming payout date and invoice reference
clear statement of the amount, invoice and expected transfer date
firm reminder citing the invoice, the agreed terms and the delay
polite call: confirm receipt, ask for the payment date, offer to re-send the invoice
escalation note for the owner with the full history attached

payments.reference: AdSense pays around the 21st; amount is a planning figure, not a confirmed payout.
Reels bonus programme payout; terms set by Meta.
Monthly subscription collection; gateway settlement pending review.
Twelve tracked leads, ₹8.4L pipeline; payment overdue per agreed terms.
UPI settlement cycle; amount is a planning figure.

morning_briefing.rule: Vyomaraj and Jarvis share the updates and data with the owner every morning — voice or email, text or WhatsApp. In this prototype the briefing is drafted, never sent.

audit.agents: Finance and auditing agents check the data before any reminder goes out
checks: due date matches the agreed terms
history of previous reminders is attached
audit.disputes: If a platform disputes an amount, the reminder stops and the owner is notified the same morning.
